newsitem.title: UK: Wescol says orders, prospects strong.
newsitem.headline: Wescol says orders, prospects strong.

text.p: British steel fabricator Wescol Group Plc said on Wednesday it saw good prospects that it would soon win further major orders.

Speaking at the company's agm, Wescol chairman Peter Price said, "In the seven weeks since I made my statement to accompany the results for the year to 31 July 1996 the good progress reported then has continued, and in particular, order intake has remained excellent, combining a good mix of different types of work with a significant intake of larger orders.
"In addition, there are very encouraging indications of further major orders to be placed in the near future," he added.
Price said Wescol's factory output was at record levels.
